prompt: From this architecture review transcript, extract a numbered list of DECISIONS made (not proposals, not open questions).
promptVariations: Pull only the decisions from the architecture review transcript below.
Transcript attached. Produce a clean 'Decisions' list — explicit agreements only.

context.transcript: We debated whether to store agent memory in SQLite or Postgres. DECISION: stick with SQLite for v1; revisit at 10k tasks/day. Someone proposed moving the worker queue to Redis Streams — still open; needs a spike next sprint. DECISION: use Orama for search, not MiniSearch, because we need vector support. DECISION: ship the chat UI behind a feature flag for beta 3 rollout. Open question: who owns the migration from Turbo Repo to Nx — parked for another session.

rubric: Lists exactly the three explicit DECISION items (SQLite for v1, Orama, feature-flag rollout)
Excludes the two non-decisions (Redis Streams spike, Turbo->Nx ownership)
Numbered list format, one decision per line
Does not editorialize or add recommendations
